description: Set custom field values across media in a single batch operation, overwriting existing values. Scope the update with `mediaIds`, or with `folderId` to update every media in that folder; when both are given only `mediaIds` is used. Empty values are skipped, so this cannot clear a field. Each value that changes fires your field_updated automations, whose steps can send email, post to Slack, call webhook URLs or run connected third-party app actions. Shared dashboard links cache widget data, so field and media edits can take up to about 5 minutes to show for date ranges that include today (15 at most) and up to about 17 minutes for past ranges (60 at most); any dashboard update refreshes it at once.

fields.description: Array of field id/value pairs to set

id.description: Field `id` from list_fields or create_field (12 characters), never the database `_id`

value.description: Value to set for the field

folderId.description: Apply the field values to all media in this folder

mediaIds.description: Apply the field values to these specific media files

name: update_multiple_fields

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API
